lines.text: Go. I will keep your ridge cold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Go south. Don't look back. There's nothing back there worth the look.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Good. Holding back has always been my fault, not yours.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He called me his patience. Twelve years now, I have waited for him to come back.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He gave me the north. One winter, he gave me a block of ice with a light inside it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He is counting us.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He is held. Strike, all of you.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: He said I wait too long.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Hearthwick still sends me bread every midwinter. Burnt, usually.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Hold the line. Ice knows how. The rest of you, copy me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: How long?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I always waited until I saw. Then there was nothing left to see.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I am done waiting, Malrik. Aldra. Everyone. To the rock.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I built this wall so nobody would ever have to choose. You are making me choose.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I came for a ford, Bishop. Not for his tree. My host stops here.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I came to keep the Coinwater's peace, Malrik. Not to buy a dragon like a cart-horse.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I gave the wood one winter. I can give it another.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I have never owned anything this old. Except my regrets.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I heard.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I heard it ask. I did not hear him say no.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I know. I saw.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I know what they want.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I think I already know, old one.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I told Malrik no, once. Then I watched you carry three keys toward the Hollow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I waited too long again. The lanes are quiet. Too quiet, for a morning.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I was a boy on a mountain pass, keeping a beacon for soldiers who had gone down the road.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: I will hold the north stair, Bishop. Do what you came to do, and quickly.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice does not march for your mistakes, Bishop.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice holds its bank. Malrik, if that stone so much as hums, I'm freezing your pocket.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice is moving. I know. Write it down somewhere.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice is set. That was quick, for me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice, on the north road. You waited for us, child? Truly?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ice stays out of this war.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: It has been looking after itself for a thousand years, Your Radiance. Look where it got them.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: ...It knows my name.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: It was only ever ice. Let her up.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Kettlewick. Twice now. Perhaps it's a habit.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Malrik. That light in your hand. It moved before you did.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Malrik. Your hand is shaking. Is that you, or the stone?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Mended. Slowly. But mended.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Mother Hush. I have stood beside this mask in Malrik's camp. They were my ally's knives.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: My line is bending. Help me hold it. I'm asking. Note that.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: My ward is failing. Help me hold it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No. I don't think you can.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No. It is the one thing I am good at.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No. My lake stays out of your war.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: No. Not for now. Not ever.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: ...No. The gate stays shut.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Nobody sits. Not ever again.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Not here... not in front of them...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Not this year. Open the gate, Aldra. Or no. I will. My hands, this time.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Not yet. I think he was waiting for you. He is polite like that.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Nothing is what Malrik always asks for. At first.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Now, Bishop. Before her roots take hold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Now, Bishop. Before the spring remembers itself.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Once a rider hammered at my gate, and I stood there counting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: One fewer door. Keep yours shut, Ysolde.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Open the gate. All of it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Pits to the east, fishers to the south. Aldra, I cannot stand in two places.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Quickly, then. Before that stone in your pocket finishes its sentence.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Remember who paid for it, Seraphine. I would like to know myself.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Run, little ember. Every relic you carry makes the Hollow hungrier. You will see.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Sensible hands. Yours.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: She did. I have worse things to remember.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: She is not lying, Bishop. I have felt it under the ice. Something counting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: She left this on the sand.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: She'll take the field in five minutes. He'll take it in the last one.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Sixty winters I have kept this gate. I can keep it one more.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So be it. My lake will see you out. Slowly.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So does Malrik. He has simply never minded.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So the little ember comes to warm the wood. You are late, child. Winter got here first.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So would I. Malrik sailed home before the blood was dry. That is not mourning.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Some nights I still see the smoke.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Some things should break. Once. Properly.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Someone had to keep the light, I said.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Something came for it every winter, for a hundred winters. Nothing got past me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Something under the isle is counting. Every one that falls, it counts.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Spring is stubborn. So is winter. This is not over, child.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Stone is patient. Ice is older.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Sunwake flies with us. For the morning, at least.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Tell them I was looking at a weed.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: That ice has kept a secret for a hundred winters, ember. Think before you melt it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: That smoke is violet. Gold cloaks do not bleed violet.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: That's the last of them. Close it behind them. Gates are for closing too.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The boat my rune saw left violet smoke. Gold cloaks do not row from the north.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The Citadel stands. Aldra. I would rather not do this one alone.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The gate.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The ice... gives...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The ice holds for us, and not for them. Remember that, girl.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The lake is safe. The lake is always safe.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The orb is turned. Quickly. For me. Who's next?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: The sea... was never mine to hold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Their door is broken. Go home, stones.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then I am on your side. Hold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then I will answer for them. They will answer to nobody.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then I will spend it awake.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then I will stand down here. Ring your bells when I tell you, and bring your people to me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then it cracks. Ice was never the point. The line was.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then it is waiting.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then it will be raised. I gave my word.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then let him come. We are four. We hold.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Then the gate stays shut, and the lake stays quiet.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: There is nothing under it left to sing about.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: They have a watch. Take it back, or the ridge goes with it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: They never came back. I kept it lit all winter anyway.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: They rest here. Four minutes. They walked for three days. We hold for four minutes.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: They will come back.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: This bank is mine until the thaw, child. The thaw is a long way off.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: This coin carries the Outwall's stamp, Malrik. Dockers' wages. Where did you find it?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: This is not what you promised, Bishop. You said a door. Not a jailer.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Together, then.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Tomorrow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Tomorrow, then.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too late... again...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too late. I always arrive... too late.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too slow. Again... the ice gives way.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too slow... at the end...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too slow... forgive me. Too slow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Too slow... once more...

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Twenty. That's enough to be a town. Keep them coming.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two banners on one bank. Malrik, I begin to see why you feared her.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two children, fighting on my lake. Finish it quickly, and leave my ice alone.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two hundred dockers' wages, given as a gift.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Vessa. Still never waiting. One day, child, the road will be longer than you are.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Violet. And a candle sigil. Malrik, you are taking rowers from the gutter now.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: We came as fast as ice comes.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: We were all weeds once. Pull back.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: What did it cost you, Malrik? In Duskbarrow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: What is under it?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You are told many things, Vessa. Most of them by people standing behind you.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You broke a truce older than both of us.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You came quickly. I'll try to learn how that's done.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You carved a giant out of my lake.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You handled the Laurel too, Malrik. I have not forgotten whose knives they were.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You send a knife at farmers' carts, Malrik.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: You sent knives after her in the night, and missed. You call that a visit?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Your shadows are thorough, Malrik. I am not certain that is a compliment.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ysolde. Go home. I have no quarrel with your farms.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ysolde. I warned you about the cold. Turn back while the passes are open.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ysolde once asked me what I remember of being young. I told her: snow.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Ysolde. You were always the patient one. Why can you not wait for spring?

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Loosing! Heads down!

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Pots are packed. Point me.

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Rolling, careful with the load.

lines.speaker: unit_ash_hurler
lines.text: Should have... kept my distance.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Ash... to ash.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Fuse is short. Step back.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: Into the smoke.

lines.speaker: unit_ashveil_saboteur
lines.text: [whisper] You never saw me.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Back... in the barrow.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Crawling, crawling.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: [excited] Fresh meat.

lines.speaker: unit_barrow_ghoul
lines.text: Hungry. Always hungry.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Hyah! Riding out.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Saddle's hot. Where to?

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: [shout] Charge through them.

lines.speaker: unit_blaze_rider
lines.text: Thrown... from the saddle...

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: Keeping to the edges.

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: Let them bleed slowly.

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: So cold...

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: [whisper] I see them. They don't see me.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: [calm] Who needs mending?

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: I would rather heal, but fine.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: I'll follow the green.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: Plant me... somewhere nice.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Back... to the soil.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Horns down.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Hrm. The old wood listens.

lines.speaker: unit_bramblehorn
lines.text: [slow] Roots, lift.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Off through the brush.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Oh... ouch...

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: Pockets full of burrs.

lines.speaker: unit_burr_slinger
lines.text: These ones stick!

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Crank's wound. Bolt's glowing.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Hauling the big one over.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Jammed... at the worst time.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Line them up. One bolt, two holes.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: [angry] I'll swing the pick, then.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: Hands ready, boss.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: On my way.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_hand
lines.text: Ugh... shift's over.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: Bow's strung and warm.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: [excited] Light them up.

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: Moving, keep up!

lines.speaker: unit_ember_archer
lines.text: My fire... out...

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Andiamo! Nessuno mi ferma.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Certo, capo. Ci penso io.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Eccomi. Il più forte è arrivato.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Fuoco e acciaio! Avanti!

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Guarda questi muscoli. Bello, no?

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Non... è finita...

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Venite qui, se avete il coraggio!

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Mortar crew, standing by.

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Pull, lads, pull!

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: Shell away! Cover your ears.

lines.speaker: unit_frost_mortar
lines.text: The tube's cracked!

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Freeze in place.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Moving to high ground.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: Steady hands, cold eyes.

lines.speaker: unit_frostbow
lines.text: The string... snapped.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: If I must.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: Rest... at last.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: [tired] The master calls. I dig.

lines.speaker: unit_gloom_thrall
lines.text: Yes. Walking.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: My shield is Ysolde's.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: [shout] Face me, not them.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: The grove goes with me.

lines.speaker: unit_greenheart_oathkeeper
lines.text: The oath... holds.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: I weave my way there.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: The thread... is cut.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: The threads are ready.

lines.speaker: unit_hexweaver
lines.text: Wither, little hero.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: A needle of frost for you.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: Keeping my distance.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: The light... fades.

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: The light string hums.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: [angry] I do not break.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: Forgive me... my lord.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: Sworn, and hollow. Command me.

lines.speaker: unit_hollow_oathsworn
lines.text: The vow walks with me.

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 给您添麻烦了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 我，尽力了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 得罪了。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 您过奖了，我只是个小兵。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 是，我这就去。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 在下不才，请您吩咐。

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 请多指教。

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: A bolt of night, at your word.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: Pick one. It falls.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: Quietly, then.

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: The night... takes me back.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: Gather close, and burn together.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: I carry the flame there.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: [sad] The bowl... goes cold.

lines.speaker: unit_pyre_adept
lines.text: The bowl is lit. Speak.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Colossus... awake.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Crush.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] Melting...

lines.speaker: unit_rime_colossus
lines.text: [slow] The ground... shakes.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Aye, pulling.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Leave the sled... for me.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Right, I'll have a go.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_hauler
lines.text: Sled's empty. What's the job?

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: [calm] I saw you coming.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: I did not... see this.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: The frost shows the path.

lines.speaker: unit_rime_seer
lines.text: Winter, take them.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Aww... melted.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: [excited] Brr! Ready, ready!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Sliding over!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeling
lines.text: Stab, stab, chill!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Allá voy, con la frente en alto.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Caigo... con orgullo.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Con honor, siempre.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Mi escudo jamás se ha rendido.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¡Nadie pasa! ¡Nadie!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¡Por la gloria del hielo!

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¿Sí? El escudo más noble del norte.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Arrow's lit. Name the mark.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Finding a better angle.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Let them burn a little.

lines.speaker: unit_scorchbow
lines.text: Missed... the last one...

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: [excited] Bite, burn, bite!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: [excited] Hee hee! Me? Me!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: Pop!

lines.speaker: unit_scorchling
lines.text: Running, running!

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: My blade is sworn to Malrik.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: My oath... is kept.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: Riding in black.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: [shout] Break their line.

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Mind the splinters.

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Shards are sharp. Where?

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Shattered...

lines.speaker: unit_shardcaster
lines.text: Stepping lightly.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: [angry] Stand against the glacier.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: Even glaciers... fall.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: The Shardguard stands.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: Where I walk, the ice holds.

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Hello! Something to grow?

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Hopping along!

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Oh dear. Here goes!

lines.speaker: unit_sprigling
lines.text: Wilting...

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Back in the bottle...

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: [excited] A little thunder for you.

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Floating over, no rush.

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Out of the bottle at last!

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Blown away...

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Puff, and away!

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Quick, quick, what is it?

lines.speaker: unit_thistle_darter
lines.text: Zip!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They cut it. Then we plant it again. That is the whole of my strength.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They have a standard. Let them carry it. Banners are light. Hills are not.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They say I was born the year nothing grew. I won't let there be two.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They sell everything to somebody.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They're coming up the ramps. Every keyhole, every side. Hold yours!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They're in my roots! Please. Now, not in a season.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They're through. Ring it again, Wren.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: This one I can do alone. Keep them off me, and do not set it on fire.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Those relics aren't a prize. They're a lock.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three groves along your line, Vessa. Give me those, and I can give you a kingdom back.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three groves. Enough roots to stand on. Rise.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three messengers, three answers. I could get used to answering.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Three stones in our hands. The land listens to whoever stands on it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Together.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Too many. We were too slow, and the valley is empty.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Too slow. I was always too slow for the ones at the border.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald didn't come for my wood. He came for your relics.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald froze the brook. The old folk will slip, and his archers know it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald is on my bridge with half of winter. I could use some fire.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald! It's breaking on our side!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Torvald. You let me go once, on your wall. I remember. I will not hold back today.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Twelve years ago he sent for me one last time. Torvald too. Only us.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Two. I'm taking a side, Maelis. It's theirs.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Until spring.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Vessa, hold the crest. Please. Just once, wait.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Vessa. Stop. Please.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Vessa. They are all inside your wall. Ashby gave away his own blanket.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: When the snow closes them, the north feeds Malrik's war all winter. Out of reach.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You burned their wagons. You don't get their children.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You came. I always hoped someone would, when it was me.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You came. I told you to remember. I didn't think you'd listen.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You came when I called, Vessa. Next time, I come when you do.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You froze a grave, Aldra. I've come to open it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You know how he found me. A girl, a sapling, the frost. That part is easy to tell.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: You see, Maelis? It always comes back.
